note: San Francisco Unified School District runs the city's public schools, from preschool and transitional kindergarten through grade 12, plus county schools for students referred out of regular schools. Its online directory lists 128 entries; they are shown here as 126, because two second campuses are folded into their schools. A seven-member Board of Education, elected citywide, adopts the budget and sets policy. City College of San Francisco, the public community college, has its own elected Board of Trustees and is listed second.

board.name: Board of Education
board.meets: Regular meetings are on the second and fourth Tuesdays of the month unless otherwise noticed: closed session at 5:00 pm, public session at 6:30 pm, in the Irving G. Breyer Board Meeting Room, 555 Franklin Street, First Floor. This fall's calendar also sets regular meetings on December 1 and 15, with study sessions and monitoring workshops on other Tuesdays. Meetings are shown live and archived on SFGovTV, and can be heard by phone at (669) 900-9128. Childcare is offered at regular meetings and monitoring workshops. Seven commissioners are elected citywide to four-year terms; two student delegates also sit with the board.

budget.adoptedVote: Adopted by the Board of Education 4-3 on June 23, 2026
budget.note: The district reports a $1.36 billion operating budget (total shown is that rounded figure). It is a three-year balanced budget with $33.3 million in commitments: $8.6 million for up to 14 weeks of paid pregnancy leave, $12.2 million to guard against federal funding risks and grant freezes, and $12.5 million for student success strategies. The district projects its Unrestricted General Fund structural deficit will be eliminated in 2027-28. No per-pupil figure or prior-year total was found on SFUSD or California Department of Education pages we could open.

issues.title: Board votes to move toward neighborhood-based school assignment
issues.summary: On October 13 the Board voted 5-2 for Option C, directing staff to draft a neighborhood-based enrollment policy. Students would first be offered a seat at a neighborhood school near home; families could also apply to citywide programs such as language pathways and K-8 campuses, without a guarantee. Commissioners Alida Fisher and Supriya Ray voted no and backed Option B, which would have let families apply to any school with open seats. Staff will work with demographers on attendance-boundary maps and tiebreakers. The change is meant to take effect for students entering elementary school in fall 2028; families would apply under the new rules in fall 2027.

issues.title: How the enrollment options were narrowed
issues.summary: At an October 6 study session the Board dropped Option A, leaving Options B and C, both of which guarantee a neighborhood seat. The SF Standard reported the final policy is scheduled for adoption April 13, 2027.

issues.title: Site chosen for new Mandarin immersion TK-8 school
issues.summary: SFUSD announced the new school will start in fall 2027 sharing the Mission Education Center campus at 1670 Noe Street before moving to a permanent site. It opens with four classes (three kindergarten, one transitional kindergarten) and adds grades each year.

issues.title: 2027-28 enrollment season is open
issues.summary: Online and paper applications for 2027-28 opened October 23, 2026. Applications to Ruth Asawa School of the Arts and Lowell High School are due December 11, 2026 (SOTA applicants also audition in January). Main Round applications for TK-12 are due February 1, 2027; assignment letters go out the week of March 15, 2027.

issues.title: 2026-27 budget adopted on a 4-3 vote
issues.summary: The Board adopted a $1.36 billion operating budget on June 23, 2026 along with the 2024-27 Local Control and Accountability Plan. The district said it planned to self-certify a positive budget, up from a Qualified certification at its First Interim projection in March 2026.

methodology: Built November 4, 2026. School list: the SFUSD school directory (table view, "Showing 1 - 128 of 128 results") at https://www.sfusd.edu/schools/directory/table, opened Nov 4, 2026, for names, grades, addresses and page links. Level follows the directory's own type: schools it labels County School are shown as Continuation/Alternative; schools labeled K-8 School as K-8; schools with both early education and elementary grades as Elementary. Two directory rows that are second campuses (Claire Lilienthal's K-2 Madison campus and Rooftop's 5-8 Mayeda campus) are folded into their schools, so 126 are listed. The directory lists a grade 13 for seven high schools and three county programs, and does not define it; grades are shown as listed. One directory row, The Academy - San Francisco @ McAteer, has no grades or address in the directory, so its level and address are blank. Individual school pages could not be opened in this session (permission requests timed out), so principals are blank. Board: the district's Board of Education page and board meeting calendar (opened Nov 4). Calendar: the 2026-27 district calendar PDF and Enrollment Key Dates page (opened Nov 4).
